description: Shared infrastructure credentials for AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.). System Manager only — feature settings (which provider a feature uses, confidence thresholds, etc.) live elsewhere. Reused by every AI-powered feature in this app so credentials are stored, rotated, and audited in one place.

fields.description: Anthropic API key (from https://console.anthropic.com). Encrypted at rest via Frappe's Password field encryption. Required for any feature that selects 'Anthropic Claude'.
fields.label: Anthropic API Key

fields.description: Default Anthropic model id used when a feature does not override its own model. Pin by exact id (with the date suffix) rather than '-latest' to prevent silent quality drift on model rollover.
fields.label: Anthropic Default Model

fields.description: Check this if your Anthropic contract includes Zero Data Retention (ZDR). When checked, AI features will request ZDR-eligible processing so data sent to Anthropic is not retained after the response. This is the customer's responsibility to align with their Anthropic contract.
fields.label: Anthropic ZDR Enabled

fields.description: Reserved for future features. Leave empty if no OpenAI-backed features are in use.
fields.label: OpenAI API Key

fields.description: Reserved for future features. Default OpenAI model id used when a feature does not override its own model.
fields.label: OpenAI Default Model

name: AI Provider Settings
